definition: Richard Stuart Sutton (born 1957 or 1958) is a Canadian computer scientist.
details: He is a professor of computing science at the University of Alberta and chief scientific advisor at the Alberta Machine Intelligence Institute. He co-founded in 2026 an AI startup, Oak Lab. Sutton is considered one of the founders of modern computational reinforcement learning. In particular, he contributed to temporal difference learning and policy gradient methods. He received the 2024 Turing Award with Andrew Barto.
story: Think of a lightbulb moment: the idea was always there, but someone had to point a finger at it. Behind the jargon is an idea you could explain to a friend over coffee. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. Once you see it, you cannot unsee it. And that idea, made concrete, is Richard S. Sutton.
